subject.title: fix(agent): exit nonzero when gateway runs do not complete

question: Should `openclaw agent` treat every returned gateway `timeout`, `error`, and `cancelled` response as a nonzero shell outcome, including callers that currently parse those responses under a zero exit code?
rationale: The code and live evidence support the new behavior, but the change deliberately alters a public automation contract and should be accepted by the owner rather than inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Accept the terminal-failure exit contract
options.body: Merge the focused change so terminal gateway failures produce structured output and a nonzero process outcome.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Define a smaller compatibility boundary if any documented caller must continue parsing selected terminal responses with exit 0.

recommendation.title: Accept the terminal-failure exit contract
recommendation.body: Merge the focused change so terminal gateway failures produce structured output and a nonzero process outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: A named current-main owner could not be established from the available read-only history evidence, while the decision belongs to the gateway/CLI contract boundary.
